The same owner as Maxim Club. Excellent taste in live music, the best in fact. But it comes with international pricing so you need to ditch the Vietnamese pricing rates. However the service and security is global standard and you'll have a relaxing time to chill out with friends or business associates. They benchmark against internationals standards and won't settle for less. Safe place even for a visit alone. Previous reviews were based on pricing rates vs local rates which I find unfair. You pay premium for quality, all around the world. Just because Vietnam is emerging market doesn't mean it doesn't need local companies to progress with quality. Kudos to the long term direction of the management. Beats going for cheap and scam bars in HCMC.

MZ Wine Restaurant
Oct 2013 • Business
As our Hotel was very near MZ Wine Restaurant, we were attracted by the ambiance and pop into MZ for a drink. 
We were served by a very friendly Female Assistant Manager from the Wine Restaurant. She recommended us a variety of cocktails to taste.
We also enjoyed the live piano/violin music that starts at 7-30pm, think it lasted for an hour. 
The next 3 nights we visited again, as they were special Halloween cocktail at special price too. We also enjoyed the Pizza there.
On Halloween night we had dinner there and I enjoyed the NZ Beef Tenderloin and Pumpkin Soup. 
For the ambiance, service and music, i considered the price reasonable.
The Female Assistant Manager were really commendable with her excellent customer service as she granted us 10% discount without us prompting, 
This gave us a "WOW" feeling and will surely recommend friends to visit MZ Wine Restaurant and Club, if they are in HCM City.
